author: TeIq
content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-S1..S8; AC-6

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/llm/safety_floors.rs

**The 8 floors**:
- S1: confidence ≥ policy.autonomous_confidence_threshold
- S2: action_kind ∈ policy.autonomous_action_kinds AND ∈ {label, warn, takedown}
- S3: if action_kind = takedown, subject.kind must be 'post' (REQ-G2)
- S4: subject had no human no_action/reverse in last 30d (POLARIS_AUTONOMOUS_SUBJECT_COOLDOWN_DAYS)
- S5: per-policy rate limit not exceeded (default 60/hr; column: autonomous_rate_limit_per_hour)
- S6: 7-day reversal rate < 15% (default; per-policy override)
- S7: global_autonomous_pause cleared
- S8: cited policy has human_required_always = FALSE

**API**:
- pub async fn evaluate(&Pool, &Policy, &RecommendedAction, &Subject) -> EffectiveMode
- EffectiveMode = { Manual | Assisted { reason } | Autonomous }
- Each Manual/Assisted carries a structured `SafetyFloorTripped { which_floor, detail }` for observability

**Rust quality**:
- Each floor is a small fn returning Result<(), FloorTripped>
- Composed by evaluate() that short-circuits on the first trip but reports ALL trips in the metric (REQ-I1 polaris_llm_safety_floor_tripped_total)
- No I/O in the per-floor fns except the rate-limit + reversal-rate ones; those are cached at the call site

**Tests** (tests/llm_safety_floors.rs):
- One test per floor: confidence-too-low, kind-not-eligible, account-takedown-blocked, subject-cooldown-tripped, rate-limit-tripped, circuit-breaker-tripped, global-pause-tripped, human-required-blocked

**Blocked by**: #223 (mod_policies), #LLM-3, #LLM-5
